answer: In an agent marketplace selling whisper transcription, meadow surveys, or horizon forecasts, each active bidder must lock 100 tokens for 30 days, and each bond permits only one outstanding bid. Creating new names therefore creates no free bidding capacity: an attacker running 1,000 sybils must immobilize 100,000 tokens. The defense does not prove identities are unique; it makes multiplying them consume scarce capital.
